discovery_notes: WDW OE 2020-2022 pass; 15 WebSearch calls before the shared per-turn search limit was hit, so breadth is partial. All search_snippet. Mostly Disney Pins Blog and WDWNT. Dated series (2021/2022) released in Nov/Dec of prior year but keyed to dated year. Several dated/Halloween series are sold at both Disneyland and WDW. EPCOT festival pins 2021-2022 found only as LE/LR. Price conflicts kept (2020 booster 29.99 vs 32.99; Heroes of Xandar 12.99 vs 9.99). Gaps: Christmas 2020-2022, Halloween 2021-2022, Princess 2022, park-specific OE, Animal Kingdom/Hollywood Studios OE.
